info.title: Material Vendor Management Service
info.description: This is the API for the Material Vendor Management entity and should be the way to get or search Supplier data.

get.description: How you get a single supplier.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: A single Id of the object (in this case Material Vendor Management Supplier)

parameters.name: _dataunits
parameters.description: The data units that would be desired, default returns just core data

200.description: Returns response object which contains supplier core with requested data units

X-B3-TraceId.description: A UUID that will uniquely identify a reqest for tracking purposes

cache-control.description: Will indicate rules around caching of the content returned.

expires.description: Will indicate a time when this data should be expired in the cache, though cache-control takes precedence
